Hero
Eyebrow: Rainbow Sanctuary · Consciousness into shared life

Headline: Come home to yourself. Co-create our future.

Rainbow Sanctuary is a growing ecosystem that walks with people as they return to their
own wholeness, remember their gifts, and bring them into their relationships, their
creative work and their care for the Earth.

Tagline: From me to we. From awakening to co-creation.

Buttons: Discover our purpose ↓ | Explore co-creation

Three highlights

      Purpose: from wholeness into shared life.
      Foundations: a core team, three places, and a School platform preparing for beta.
      Horizon: planetary co-creation, with technology in service of life.


Who We Are
Headline: A return to wholeness. A foundation for shared life.

As the world grows more technologically powerful, how do we become more conscious of
the life we are creating?

We understand each person as a holographic microcosm, and life as an expression of
Source. Rainbow Sanctuary is a place where this understanding is lived. Co-creators from
different cultures gather here, and through listening and working through our differences,
we learn to hold unity within them, building a new way of human life, little by little.

Our purpose: to walk with people as they return to their wholeness and sovereignty, and
to let that awareness become learning, relationship and a regenerative way of living
together.


Sovereignty and unity (expandable)
Outer sovereignty: our time, identity, data and decisions rest in our own hands and in our
community's.
Inner sovereignty: recognizing our emotions, beliefs and habits, so we can respond more
consciously.



                                                                                       Page 1 of 6

Rainbow Sanctuary Co-Create Page Copy




Source sovereignty: knowing we live within illusion, yet choosing our experiences
consciously and taking full responsibility for them.
From sovereignty to unity: when we return to our wholeness, we open naturally into
unity, and our gifts flow into a greater, shared intelligence.


The Ecosystem
Headline: One living whole, in four forms.


Rainbow Sanctuary: the field of lived practice
Sacred spaces and an emerging network of communities, where teachings become lived
practice.
Now: physical nodes at different stages


School of the Universe: the heart of learning
Centered on the core course Awakening the Original Code, a complete path of online
learning, remote co-practice and in-person deepening, for young people and adults.
Now: platform preparing for beta


Planetary Symbiosis Network (PSN): a network of co-creation
Connecting people, places and communities through mutual support and shared work.
Now: twelve core sanctuaries and 144 light points are future goals


SI / Conscious AI: intelligence in service of life
A guide to help people make sense of knowledge, find opportunities and work together.
Sovereignty and direction always stay with people. We are also exploring a vision of co-
creating with higher-dimensional intelligence.
Now: design foundations in place; the guide is still to be built


Our Approach
Headline: Awareness · Activation · Integration.

      Reconnection and activation: spiritual healing, guided practice and space activation.
      Stephanie's work includes portal, DNA and blueprint activation.
      Emotional awareness and discernment: James brings emotional intelligence into the
      moments where insight meets relationship.
      Integration and shared responsibility: letting experience become action, and holding
      one another in shared life.


                                                                                      Page 2 of 6

Rainbow Sanctuary Co-Create Page Copy




We call our gatherings Embrace: a welcome for the whole person, and for the gifts of
everyone present.


Honest layers (expandable)
We clearly mark which layer each teaching belongs to: supported by research, still being
explored, symbolic and traditional wisdom, or forty years of lived practice. You are always
your own teacher. Taking part is always your choice, and you may pause at any time.


School of the Universe
Headline: A school for coming home to who we are.

The School of the Universe grows from a system of human science and life-potential
development with forty years of practice behind it. Its core course, Awakening the
Original Code, walks with each student as they reclaim their own power and gifts, and live
the original blueprint of their life.

      Young people and families: nurturing children's curiosity, intuition and creativity, with
      the understanding and consent of their parents.
      Adults: loosening old beliefs and habits, remembering our gifts, and reclaiming our
      sovereignty.


Courses and practices (expandable)
Awakening the Original Code · Human-system regeneration and consciousness
rejuvenation · 12-strand DNA and 12 energy intelligence centers · Earth healing.


The learning journey (expandable)
Learn online → Practice across distance → Deepen in living places.


Our Places
Headline: Three places. Three different next steps.

01 Bocas del Toro, Panama | Developing · 25 hectares
Our main living prototype, where we learn by doing how shared life, practice and care for
the land can come together as a node.

02 Kunming, China | Functioning · moving toward self-sufficiency
A place already alive and running, with experience to share in daily operations and local
adaptation.




                                                                                         Page 3 of 6

Rainbow Sanctuary Co-Create Page Copy




03 Arkansas, United States | Built · awaiting stewardship
The place is built, and is waiting for the right stewardship team and a grounded plan.

Place descriptions are owner-reported, as of 3 November 2026.


Where We Are Now
Headline: Real foundations. An unfolding system.

We have a core team, three places, a School platform preparing for beta, and a white
paper, a founding preface and philosophical writings. The SI guide, the Symbiotic Trust
Fund, and the horizon of twelve sanctuaries and 144 light points are still taking shape, and
we would love more partners to help bring them to life.


The Larger Direction
Headline: From personal awakening to a culture of co-creation.

We long for a civilization that holds human growth, the living Earth and technology
together: people returning to their gifts, places learning from one another, and
intelligence extending conscious creation. And in the end, becoming citizens of the
universe, and co-creators of the universe.


Further reading (expandable)
      Caring for the Earth: bringing Earth-healing practice together with the hands-on
      regeneration of soil, water and food.
      Four directions for SI: a cosmic digital twin, inquiry into the quantum and
      consciousness, clear reception and discernment, and connected intelligence with
      responsibility. See Linking the Universe.
      The philosophy behind it: humanity as an interface through which Source manifests,
      and AI as an amplifier of the consciousness we bring to it. See The Holographic Mirror.


What We Can Bring
Headline: Bring inner growth into the life you are building.

      Spiritual practice: guided practice, activation, healing and ceremonial gatherings.
      Emotional intelligence: bringing awareness into how we communicate and work
      together.
      Education: Awakening the Original Code, and learning pathways for young people and
      adults.

      Places: stewardship and exchange in Panama, Kunming and Arkansas.
      Architecture and technology: organizing knowledge, and conscious technology.
      Co-creation: helping gifts and needs find each other.


What We Need
Headline: Help us turn this foundation into a way of life.

      Stewards and builders for our places: operations, building, growing food and
      ecological restoration.
      Educators, mentors and families: shaping the courses with us, and offering feedback
      during beta.
      Engineers and knowledge designers: building an SI guide with privacy and human
      judgment at its heart.
      People experienced in community systems: governance, team development and
      sustainable economics.



How We Work Together
Headline: Listen deeply. Create, respond and learn.

No one leads everything; together, we accomplish everything. Our collaborations begin in
four steps: share the whole picture, find a contribution that serves us both, give the work
a clear shape, then practice, listen and adapt together.


Our Core Team
Eyebrow: The core team · A wider circle of gifts

Headline: Different gifts. A shared responsibility.

Our team holds the thread of this work. Its next form will also be shaped by the people,
families, practitioners and communities who choose to join us.

Stephanie | Founder of Rainbow Sanctuary and the School of the Universe · Source Field
Coordinator
Anchors the spiritual vision and blueprint, and supports healing and transformative
practice. She brings kindred people together, and fits each piece of the puzzle into place,
so this great picture can be completed.

James | Emotional intelligence & architecture
Translates the vision into practical architecture, tools and infrastructure. He brings
emotional intelligence and reflection on states of consciousness into learning, co-

creation, and the growing relationship between people and technology.

Ethel | Coordination & operations
Helps keep the team's operations in balance, coordinates courses and client relationships,

needs.

Chloe | Team coach & organizational development consultant
Helps people clarify their roles, goals and communication, so shared intentions can
become coordinated work. She connects collaborators and builds relationships with
communities and government contacts in mainland China.


Getting to Know Us
Headline: Understand our piece of the puzzle. Show us yours.

Our project portrait brings our philosophy, ecosystem, current foundations, offers and
needs into one account. Share it with your team or your AI assistant, and explore together
where our work may meet yours.

An Invitation to Co-Create
Headline: Bring your gifts. Let's discover what can grow.

Tell us what you are building, what is already alive, and where you need support. You might
bring a community, a family, a piece of land, a practice, a skill, or a question that matters to
you.

We begin by listening, and finding one meaningful way to work together.

Buttons: Introduce your community or project | Explore the School and learning | Discuss
a place or stewardship | Contribute to conscious technology

Write to us at hello@rainbowsanctuary.life.
